responsibility: Provides the scheduler model for Cortex-A7, covering its limited dual-issue integer core plus scalar FP and simplified NEON behavior. It defines a coarse NEON type classification, issue/resource reservations for branches, integer ALU/multiply, load/store, VFP arithmetic/divide/transfers, and broad NEON categories, together with selected bypasses, to tune code generation for Cortex-A7-class in-order cores.
